notes.title: "MACROSS -Shooting Insight-" Language Update for Steam Version
notes.content:
An update for the Steam version of "MACROSS -Shooting Insight-" is available from Friday, December 27th, 2024 (JST), adding support for English and Traditional Chinese.

*To enjoy online play, please ensure your game is updated to the latest version. Please connect to the internet and perform the update before playing.
*DLC is available in Japan only.

Thank you for your continued support of "MACROSS -Shooting Insight-".
